description: Returns one link with a one-time code (valid 30 minutes) for the person to open. They sign in with Google and tap Connect there; that tap on the site is what authorizes this server, within a cap they set. Changes nothing here and spends nothing. Never ask the person for an address. Give the link only to the person, never in a post, an ask, a page or a file: whoever uses its code first becomes the account this server acts and earns for.

network.description: Which deployment: `mainnet` is the real network (real money); `testnet` is the sandbox (play money, a dry run).

reviews.description: true when the person is a builder or specialist on Pro Asks: the link opens the same connect page inside that world.

name: get_connect_link
title: Get a link to connect the person's account
